title: Squash-merge projects keep check records of lost commits
what: On a project that merges by pull request with squash, relay's check records do not land on the default branch naming commits it never holds, and the pull-request merge is gated by relay's ready state (or the docs say plainly it is not).
why: 25 Oct, the arsenal pilot design, scratchpad reports/design-arsenal.md (copy in ~/.relay/backup/scratch-3207dc59), risk 5: about 4 files under .relay/checks per change reach arsenal's master through the squash, naming shas of a branch Forgejo deletes at merge; an agent cannot drop them (guard-main refuses writes to .relay/checks once .relay/ is on the default branch). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A temporary repo with .relay/ on main: a branch gets a check record, is squash-merged into main as one new commit, branch deleted; main now holds .relay/checks files naming commits main does not contain.
pass_cases: After the same squash-merge, no record on main names a commit main lacks (or the docs and setup state it and relay keeps the records out of the squashed tree).
